title.hr: OSI i TCP/IP: koji sloj, koji uređaj
title.en: OSI vs TCP/IP: which layer, which device

concept.hr: Dva modela slojeva i sloj na kojem radi svaki protokol i uređaj
concept.en: Two layer models, and the layer each protocol and device works at

summary.hr: Kartice s uređajima, protokolima i problemima stavljaju se na slojeve OSI-ja i TCP/IP-a; preklopnik čita do 2, usmjernik do 3, krajevi sve.
summary.en: Place devices, protocols and problems on the OSI and TCP/IP layers: a switch reads up to 2, a router up to 3, the two ends all of them.
